panels.description:
Использование CPU в % от 1 ядра процессора ноды Kubernetes.

Например, 200 % значит, что утилизировалось 2 ядра CPU.

targets.expr: max by (pod, container, instance) ($rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod_name", container=~"$name", container!="POD", container!=""}[$interval]))
kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource="cpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod_name", container=~"$name"}
kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="cpu", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod_name", container=~"$name"}

panels.title: CPU usage ($name)

panels.description:

panels.description:
Number of times processes in the pod has been throttled/limited.

Metric from`nr_throttled` in `/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu/kubepods/${QOS}/pod${UUID}/cpu.stat`

See also: https://www.kernel.org/doc/Documentation/scheduler/sched-bwc.txt

targets.expr: max by (pod, container, instance) ($rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod_name", container=~"$name", container!="POD", container!=""}[$interval]))

panels.title: Throttled periods

panels.description:
Throttled/total periods ratio.

Metric from`nr_throttled` in `/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu/kubepods/${QOS}/pod${UUID}/cpu.stat`

See also: https://www.kernel.org/doc/Documentation/scheduler/sched-bwc.txt

targets.expr:
max by (pod, container, instance) ($rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod_name", container=~"$name", container!="POD", container!=""}[$interval]))
    /
max by (pod, container, instance) ($rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod_name", container=~"$name", container!="POD", container!=""}[$interval]))

panels.title: Throttled periods, %

panels.description:
Cumulative count of memory allocation failures:

* pgfault - Number of page faults the system has made per second (minor + major).
* pgmajfault - Number of major faults per second the system required loading a memory page from disk.

targets.expr: max by (pod, container, instance) ($rate(container_memory_failures_total{failure_type="pgfault", scope="container", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod_name", container=~"$name", container!="POD", container!=""}[$interval]))

panels.title: Memory allocation failures: container/pgfault ($name)

panels.description:
Cumulative count of memory allocation failures:

* pgmajfault - Number of major faults per second the system required loading a memory page from disk.

title: Kubernetes apps
description: Per-container resource usage from cadvisor and kube-state-metrics. Panels requiring standalone-cadvisor, VPA or custom logging metrics have been removed - those metrics are not collected in this cluster. All cadvisor selectors are deduplicated with max by(), because kubelet is scraped twice.
